name: Struvo
pitch: Verified building companies, rated on real jobs.
card: Verified building companies, rated on real jobs.
roleTodoDetail: struvo.fr does not name a personal title.
paragraphs: Struvo’s site presents it as the trusted third party for the building trade. The page says it is not another directory: verified companies, certified reviews after a real job, and a selected network.
The headline is “Find a reliable professional, without stress or a bad surprise.”
Verification covers SIRET, Kbis, and insurance: an automatic OCR check against criteria, then a review. The site says this is not a simple online listing.
The Struvo badge is earned after seniority or several jobs, and a certified rating. A Premium badge is for companies that accept job-site audits.

Clients can upload before, during, and after photos. The site says those photos are timestamped and geolocated, and that only the client uploads them. It also mentions random or planned on-site checks.
How it works, as listed on the site: search verified companies rated on objective criteria, follow the job with a clear record, then leave a certified review after the real work.
For companies, the site describes a monthly subscription for visibility. The first five companies in each trade get one year free. The badge is then earned from proof and certified reviews.
features: Companies checked before they are listed
No anonymous reviews, and no reviews that are not tied to a job
Five objective quality criteria per review
SIRET, Kbis, and insurance checks, then a review
Badge after seniority or several jobs, plus a certified rating
Premium badge for companies that accept job-site audits
Client photos before, during, and after, timestamped and geolocated

name: Gymmy
pitch: Gym and studio software: schedule, members, payments, and a website.
card: Gym and studio software: schedule, members, payments, and a website.
why: I train in a lot of different gyms, and I kept running into the same frustrating experience in gym apps. So I built one complete package, with every tool a gym, a CrossFit box, or a pilates studio needs, and I used AI so it stays current with how people actually work.
paragraphs: Gymmy’s site says it gives gyms time back with their members and runs operations, with a modular dashboard for owners and an assistant for members.

The owners page describes schedule, members, memberships, and payments in one place. The pricing page says the plan includes a website. The terms of service say Gymmy is online software published by StakeLab Pte. Ltd.: a dashboard for owners and coaches (schedule, programming, members, payments) and an assistant for members.

WODs and programming, including import from an existing document
Several gyms on one account

Guided migration from other software
